transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?
I've been feeling deeply depressed, sad, and completely empty inside for about a year now. It has gotten so heavy that I finally decided to come to the clinic today to get some help.
Have you ever experienced periods of abnormally elevated or irritable mood, where you felt extremely happy, energetic, or impulsive, even if it was just for a short time?

No, I have never experienced periods of abnormally elevated mood, extreme happiness, or high energy. My mood has mostly just been very down and depressed. I've never felt impulsive or hyperactive like that.
Have you ever experienced any unusual perceptions, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others cannot, or had thoughts that you believe are not based in reality?
Yes, I have heard voices when no one is there, and I've had thoughts that others tell me aren't real. These experiences only seem to happen when my depression is at its very worst.
Do the voices and unusual thoughts occur exclusively during your depressive episodes, or have you experienced them at other times when your mood was not depressed?
Yes, those voices and strange thoughts only happen when I'm feeling deeply depressed. I have never experienced them during times when my mood is normal or when I'm not feeling down.

Can you estimate how long you typically experience these depressive episodes with voices and strange thoughts, and have you ever had a period of at least two weeks where you had delusions or hallucinations without a major depressive episode?

This current depression has been going on continuously for about a year now. I have never had a period, let alone two weeks, where I experienced those voices or strange thoughts without also being deeply depressed.
For the entire duration of your year-long depression, have the voices and strange thoughts been consistently present, or have they come and gone in intervals within that depressive episode?

They haven't been there constantly; they only started after my depression began a year ago and have come and gone in intervals. But they only ever show up during those times when my depression gets really heavy, and never when I am feeling okay.

Can you think of any period, even if brief, where you had delusions or hallucinations without significant depressive symptoms, or do the psychotic symptoms always coincide with the worsening of your depressive symptoms?

No, I have never had those experiences without being severely depressed. They always coincide with the worsening of my low mood and only happen when I'm feeling deeply down. I have never experienced them during a period when I wasn't feeling depressed.

Are you certain that you've never had even a brief period, maybe just a few days, where you experienced delusions or hallucinations without feeling depressed, or has it always been tied to your depressive episodes?
Yes, I am completely certain. I have never had those experiences, even for a few days, when my mood was normal. They are always entirely tied to my deepest periods of depression.

Just to confirm, you're absolutely sure that the voices and strange thoughts have only occurred when you're deeply depressed and have never happened, not even briefly, when you weren't experiencing significant depressive symptoms?
Yes, I am absolutely sure about that. Those voices and strange thoughts only happen during the times when I am deeply depressed, and they have never once occurred when my mood was normal or okay.
